validatedTree: baseCommit plus the changes identified by sourceFileSha256 (documentation excluded)
scope: CORE-HARDENING structure foundation item 2, second step: inconsistencies 2, 3 and 5 to 8 found while moving decisions into policy.rs (1 and 4 are in core-policy-followup-2026-11-05-validation.json; 9 belongs to item 3)
2: installation approvals are read with AppAction::Observe (use, or runtime management read; previously FollowJob, renamed); a change answers with the record read in its own transaction before commit
3: app creation, app display-name change and shared component publication write in a transaction and recheck the administrator with admin_locked before commit

5 and 8: every queued job (runtime, database, build, image upload, log request, dev session) rechecks through policy::recheck_queued; a definite denial is user_disabled or permission_revoked, an unreadable recheck is database_unavailable (diagnostic_unavailable for log requests); a refused database job leaves the installation's database state unchanged
6: test acceptance is admitted with Request(accept) (a delegation needs accept and read) and decided again inside its transaction after the runtime lock and the health check
7: GET /api/v1/apps/{app}/dev-sessions/by-request/{request} decides Manage(dev_session) like reading the session
Regression harness: a suite that stops at a failed check is recorded as a FAIL row and later suites still run
behaviorChanges: GET /api/v1/installations/{id}/permissions and MCP get_installation_permissions: administrators and deployers of a company-disabled prod app now read its approvals (previously 403 app_disabled). PUT on such an installation answers 200 with the committed record (previously it committed and then answered 403 app_disabled)

POST /api/v1/apps, POST /api/v1/apps/{app}/name and POST /api/v1/components: an administrator revoked or disabled while the write waits on a lock gets 403 and nothing is written (previously 200 and written)

POST /api/v1/apps/{app}/test-acceptance: a delegation without read gets 403 delegation_scope_denied before any other check (previously admitted); a developer whose grant is revoked while the request waits on the runtime lock gets 403 and nothing is recorded (previously recorded)
GET /api/v1/apps/{app}/dev-sessions/by-request/{request}: a credential without dev_session on the app's dev environment gets 403 (previously the session was returned to its creating credential)

Queued database jobs, including a deployment's own preparation row queued again after a restart, accept the environment's management grant (deploy in prod) like other queued work. Previously only administrators and dev developers passed, and a refusal also set the installation's db_status to failed

Queued runtime jobs of a disabled user fail with user_disabled (previously permission_revoked). Builds record user_disabled or database_unavailable and log requests diagnostic_unavailable when the recheck cannot read (previously permission_revoked). Image uploads keep permission_revoked, user_disabled and database_unavailable instead of image_import_failed
